plant.cvs: 'Asplenifolia' – fern-leaved but broader and more open · 'Columnaris' (Tallhedge) – narrow upright with normal oval leaves, used for hedging
plant.foliage: deciduous; very narrow, wavy, thread-like dark green leaves turning yellow in autumn
plant.hardinessNote: Very hardy throughout the UK, coping with winters colder than -20°C.
plant.pollination: not applicable; grown for foliage and form, sets little fruit
plant.prune: Little needed. Lightly trim in late winter to keep the column tight or remove any stray stems.
plant.resilience: Very cold-hardy and tolerant of damp soils and urban conditions. Pests: largely trouble-free; occasional aphids.
sources: General knowledge of Frangula alnus and the FINE LINE cultivar from US nursery and breeder descriptions as remembered, not checked online
RHS and UK native-flora knowledge of the species as remembered, not checked online
plant.toxicity: Berries and bark are poisonous if eaten, causing vomiting and diarrhoea. Keep away from children, dogs and cats. This form sets few berries.
uncertain: latin: label name 'Alnus Fine Line Frangula' interpreted as Frangula alnus (syn. Rhamnus frangula) FINE LINE ('Ron Williams'). The cultivar code is recalled, not verified.
hardiness: H7 is inferred from the species, a UK native, and from US zone 2–3 ratings. An RHS rating for this cultivar is not confirmed.
height/spread: from US nursery descriptions as remembered (about 5–7 ft by 2–3 ft). UK figures not checked.
soilWarning: left blank. No confident specific constraint known.
compliance: plant breeders' rights or US plant patent number not known. No Schedule 9 listing, since the species is native to the UK. Plant passport needs are not checked.
sunMin: 50 is a judgement. Tolerates part shade, but form and density are best in sun.
container: judged 'with care'. Suitable only in a large pot kept watered.
peak: given as the foliage season. Flowers are insignificant (roughly May–Jun).
toxicity: based on the species (anthraquinone purgative in bark and berries). Berry set on this cultivar is reported as low, but this is not verified.
plant.uses: Narrow screening · vertical accent in small or contemporary gardens · large containers · formal rows
plant.visual: Narrow upright column of feathery, fern-like dark green leaves · yellow autumn colour · tiny greenish flowers in early summer
plant.water: Water regularly through the first year until roots establish, then only in long dry spells.
